notes.title: May 11th 2014 patch notes for Narcissu 1st & 2nd
notes.content:
This update only updates the engine and does not touch the game script files so saves should not be harmed.

Bugs fixed: 

[url=https://github.com/sekaiproject/ponscripter-fork/issues/28]#28[/url] - Workaround for bug in SDL2 regarding maximizing the game, minimizing the game, and then restoring the game.

[url=https://github.com/sekaiproject/ponscripter-fork/issues/29]#29[/url], [url=https://github.com/sekaiproject/ponscripter-fork/issues/59]#59[/url],[url=https://github.com/sekaiproject/ponscripter-fork/issues/60]#60[/url], [url=https://github.com/sekaiproject/ponscripter-fork/issues/61]#61[/url] - Making the game less picky about mouse click detection to fix reported issues

tags.bug: - Workaround for bug in SDL2 regarding maximizing the game, minimizing the game, and then restoring the game.
- Making the game less picky about mouse click detection to fix reported issues
